audience: church administrators and pastoral teams who use ChurchSuite

useCases.title: Find small groups, their times and members
useCases.text: The AI lists small groups with day, time and place, and the members of a group, with their names looked up from contacts or children.

useCases.title: See who serves in a rota ministry
useCases.text: The AI lists the ministries of the Rotas module, and the people who serve in them, with names looked up from contacts or children.

useCases.title: Report attendance over a period
useCases.text: The AI reads headcounts per gathering and date for a date window and sums up the trend.

useCases.title: Look up upcoming events and service plans
useCases.text: The AI lists calendar events in a date window, service plans and the running order of a plan.

useCases.title: Find a contact and read or add a note
useCases.text: The AI finds an address book contact, reads their pastoral notes, and adds a new note to the record.
